Digital data

On the page of each tide gauge, you can download tidal predictions for one calendar year in the available standard formats.

Do you want customized tidal data (e.g., a different reference height) or do you need data early for next year? Then please use this order form (in German only).
The provision and use of tidal data is subject to the conditions contained in the user fee regulation for digital data (in German only). Please note that when ordering tidal data that does not comply with standard formats or that is preliminary, a provision fee may apply.

Tide Tables

The tide tables contain detailed forecasts (times and heights) for 38 European ports. They are supplemented by mean tide curves, tide charts, as well as tidal differences and tidal parameters for approximately 700 other locations. The introductory chapters contain detailed definitions of tidal terminology and examples of how to use the tide tables.

Available through bookstores.

Tide Calendar

The compact tide calendar provides information on high and low water times at approximately 180 tide gauge locations in the German Bight and its river basins.

Additional content includes sun and moon rise and set times, mean high water and low water heights, and an overview of spring and neap times.

Available through bookstores.
